name: Ishan
bio: A third-year interaction design student with a deep-rooted passion for interactive data visualization. I focus on data analysis, systems design, user research and user-centric design. Apart from being a student and a division 3 footballer, I use my lens to capture the unnoticed — the fleeting moments of everyday life that often go unrecognized in this fast-paced world. Some of my photographs had been exhibited at Museo Camera, Gurgaon.
